runners.name: Asset
runners.spotlight: Minor honours all four starts; back to 1m from 1m2f when second in a Windsor novice (good to firm) 13 days ago, put firmly in her place by the winner; not progressing but clearly the best form claims in this tiny field.
runners.comment: Four minor honours; not progressing but clearly the best form claims in this tiny field
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Albemagic
runners.spotlight: Beaten 22l at Carlisle (7f, soft) on debut but his 6l second of four when 33-1 again in a novice at Chester (7.6f, good) four weeks ago was a great deal better; shapes as if 1m will help but Asset has markedly better form.
runners.comment: 6l second of four at Chester (7.6f, good) four weeks ago was great deal better than debut

runners.name: Feliz Navidad
runners.spotlight: Fifth of six in maidens at Beverley (8.4f, good) in June and Redcar (7f, good to firm) last Saturday, showing modest form on debut but suffering a heavy defeat last time; may prove capable of better in due course but seemingly best watched for now.
runners.comment: Modest form on debut but a heavy defeat next time; may do better in due course

runners.name: Calef
runners.spotlight: Front rank long way when third in a Catterick maiden (5f, good to firm) on the third of her four starts, her most professional performance and best form; get messed around early and looked less straightforward at Hamilton (5f, good) last time but ran on to finish a head behind Onslaught on same terms; they are the two leading form contenders, albeit not setting a high standard.
runners.comment: Ran on to finish a head behind Onslaught latest; they are the two leading form contenders

runners.name: Onslaught
runners.spotlight: Very green when last of six here (6f, good) on debut but he left that form way behind when an always-prominent third of six in maiden at Hamilton (5f, good) three weeks later, finishing narrowly in front of Calef on same terms as today; should figure prominently again.
runners.comment: Left debut form way behind when an always-prominent third of six at Hamilton (5f, good)

runners.name: Naval Cop
runners.spotlight: Too green on debut at Bath (5f, good) but made most in a novice at York (6f, good to firm) four weeks later, finishing only sixth of eight but that performance showed promise and she has a useful sprinting pedigree.
runners.comment: Made most at York (6f, good to firm) second start, only sixth of eight but showing promise

runners.name: The Mean Fiddler
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns breeze-up 2yo by No Nay Never; first foal; dam US 1m/8.5f turf winner (including Grade 3) out of maiden half-sister to 1m4f Grade 1 winner Sarah Lynx; tongue tied for debut; needs a close look.
runners.comment: 200,000gns breeze-up 2yo by No Nay Never; dam US 1m/8.5f turf winner, including Grade 3

runners.name: Shaqra Queen
runners.spotlight: By Holy Roman Emperor; fifth foal; sister to 1m/1m1f winner Way To Dubai (RPR 96), half-sister to two winners including Lady Zoumzain (Listed-placed 5f/6f including 2yo; 92); dam German 7.5f 2yo winner, half-sister to Italian 1m Group 3 winner Salford Secret; one to note from powerful stable whose 2yos continue to make a serious impact.
runners.comment: Newcomer to note from powerful stable whose 2yos continue to make a serious impact

runners.name: Bolt Of Blue
runners.spotlight: 115,000euros breeze-up purchase, by Blue Point; 20-1 when fifth of six in a maiden at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) 11 days ago, making an awkward start and never dangerous; could be a lot wiser this time but two of today's rivals have clearly accomplished more.
runners.comment: 115,000euros 2yo; could be a lot wiser on second start but others have accomplished more

runners.name: Mount King
runners.spotlight: Last four wins have been over C&D, including when he was switched to this headgear nine days ago and got up close home to register his best show this season (The New Bay Pearl fourth); back up 3lb but still well treated on 2025 form; has to be in serious calculations.
runners.comment: Last four wins were C&D, including when he was switched to this headgear nine days ago

runners.name: Stella Lucente
runners.spotlight: Finished second or third in her first six starts, before off the mark in a five-runner handicap at Hamilton (1m, good to firm) nine days ago in second-time blinkers; often front-runner, including for that win; up 5lb but just a 3yo and could have more to offer.
runners.comment: Off mark in five-runner handicap at Hamilton (1m) nine days ago in second-time blinkers

runners.name: Bradbury
runners.spotlight: 3yo who wore an eyeshield over 1m2f on last three starts, winning at Leicester (good) and Wetherby (good to firm) on first two occasions; never dangerous at Beverley latest but it was another creditable run; not the most straightforward and needs extra on this return to 1m, but still respected given questions over today's opposition.
runners.comment: Has done well over 1m2f with eyeshield; needs extra but respected given today's opposition

runners.name: Coolree
runners.spotlight: Has gained all four handicap wins over the extended 1m at Beverley, two this May; underwhelming prospects judged on two runs here, admittedly back in 2024 but he looks opposable seeing as he may well need a career best.
runners.comment: Has gained all four handicap wins over the extended 1m at Beverley, two this May

runners.name: Master Of Entropy
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who's failed to make a serious impact in his three handicaps (7.6f, 6f and 7f); dropped 5lb in the process and returns to 1m but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden; failed to make a serious impact in his three handicaps (7.6f, 6f and 7f)

runners.name: Polygram
runners.spotlight: 0-15 overall; Ayr (1m2f) 13 days ago saw her finish runner-up for the third time but she dictated the pace in a five-runner race that day and others seem to have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: 0-15; second at Ayr (1m2f) 13 days ago when she dictated the pace in a five-runner race

runners.name: The New Bay Pearl
runners.spotlight: 0-8 (placed three times) for Roger Varian but hasn't shown enough in her four races for new yard this term, fourth of seven to Mount King over C&D last time; continues to fall in the weights.
runners.comment: Maiden who hasn't shown enough in her four races for new yard this term

runners.name: Holloway Boy
runners.spotlight: He hasn't won as often as one of his ability probably should but he is a tough and reliable performer who was as good as ever with his excellent second of eight in a Group 2 at Ascot (1m, good to firm) 15 days ago; sets the standard and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Smart miler who was second in Ascot Group 2 two weeks ago; sets the standard; big player
runners.owner: N White, S White, T White & E Burke

runners.name: Model Yuko
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; close third in a handicap at Goodwood (1m2f, good) 12 months ago represents her best form but it is still a level or two beneath what will be required today; hood (tried on final 3yo start) returns.
runners.comment: Prominent racer; even her peak form (1m2f) looks a level or two below what is needed here

runners.name: Cerulean Bay
runners.spotlight: Two wins in 1m handicaps at Goodwood last autumn; began the season with three good runs, notably his second of 18 in a 1m handicap at York in May, and latest disappointment can be attributed to his messy start (reared as the stalls opened); should go well.
runners.comment: Smart handicapper; had excuse at York last time and earlier form is solid; should go well

runners.name: Point Lynas
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; successful in this race in 2024 but that wide-margin win represents his last victory; solid fourth in a good York handicap in May; should be in the thick of it.
runners.comment: Front-runner; easy win in this race in 2024; good fourth latest; should go well
runners.owner: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall

runners.name: Mostar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Not far behind Crystal Flyer when fourth in a fillies' Listed event over C&D 19 days ago; this is a deeper race though.
runners.comment: Not far behind Crystal Flyer here last time but this is a stronger race
runners.owner: J Fyffe, A Edmondson & L McGurty

runners.name: Crystal Flyer
runners.spotlight: Back to her best when 66-1 second in a fillies' Listed event over C&D 19 days ago; this represents a much stiffer assignment.
runners.comment: 66-1 second in a fillies' Listed race over C&D 19 days ago; this represents a stiffer task
runners.owner: Castle Racing Co Ltd & Mps Racing Ltd

runners.name: Jez Bomb
runners.spotlight: Back down to 1m when first and second in his last two outings, on his only appearances at this track; an in-form candidate who has plenty of earlier form at 1m2f, including an AW win; respected.
runners.comment: An in-form candidate at this track over 1m and he has plenty of earlier form at 1m2f

runners.name: Moonjid
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a breakthrough win at Nottingham (1m) and back on the scoresheet by a short head when making all at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) last month; rather mixed this term but his seventh of eight at Windsor last time came in warm race and today's opposition is less demanding.
runners.comment: Rather mixed this term but won penultimate start and his latest was in a warm race

runners.name: Percy's Daydream
runners.spotlight: Made the running when 1m2f handicap winner (good to firm) this year at Doncaster and Beverley; this is a less demanding task than her last two starts, so a return to winning ways can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Set pace for two 1m2f wins this year; this is less demanding task than her last two starts

runners.name: Pomme Pomme
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; commenced handicap career with a five-timer in May/June 2025; ran respectably under Rose Dawes at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) on latest start but that was good enough for only fifth of seven; others may have the edge.
runners.comment: Ran respectably under Rose Dawes latest but that was good enough for only fifth of seven

runners.name: Without Compromise
runners.spotlight: All three wins were 1m2f on Newcastle AW last October-December; his three races this year suggest that the handicapper has caught up; this is also only his third race on turf, having twice been towards rear last June, so he has a bit to prove on this first run since his second wind surgery.
runners.comment: All three wins were 1m2f on Newcastle AW last year; third turf race, after second wind op

runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: 22-race maiden but he has shown winning potential, including when second in a 0-50 classified event at Leicester (6f, good to firm; blinkered first time) on his recent stable debut; draw could have been kinder.
runners.comment: 0-22 but often placed; good 2nd on stable debut 12 days ago; draw could have been kinder

runners.name: Rain Cap
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far on his last two starts and this veteran is only 1lb higher than for his win in this event last year; well drawn; solid claims.
runners.comment: Won this race off 1lb lower last year; well drawn; another big run can be expected

runners.name: Eldeyaar
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run with a front-running 6f win at Thirsk in April; not so good since but he is well drawn to attack and this track suits his aggressive racing style; one to take seriously.
runners.comment: Made all at Thirsk in April; less good since but well berthed to attack today; chance

runners.name: Starsong
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Brighton last season; the odd good effort this time around but her last two runs haven't been her best; return to 6f is a plus, at least.
runners.comment: The odd good run this year but below her best on last two starts; return to 6f is a plus

runners.name: Battenburg Belle
runners.spotlight: Made it tenth time lucky with her win at Catterick (6f, good to firm) last month; 7.4f probably stretched her last time and this should prove more suitable.
runners.comment: 6f win at Catterick last month; stretched by 7.4f latest; this should be more suitable

runners.name: Miss Magic Dragon
runners.spotlight: Below par on her last two starts but she was in good form in May and is only 2lb higher than for her Bath win (5.7f, good); revival may be predicted by the betting.
runners.comment: Of interest on her spring form but she needs to rebound from two lesser displays

runners.name: Coiled
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden; well beaten in two runs for new yard this year; too much to prove.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; well beaten in two runs for new yard this year; too much to prove

runners.name: Go Victor
runners.spotlight: Huge chance on last summer's best, as he's 7lb lower than for his Thirsk success last July; yet to shine this season but drops in grade and needs a close market check.
runners.comment: Yet to shine this year but drops in grade and needs a close market check

runners.name: My Boy Jack
runners.spotlight: 0-26 on turf and, while he is likely to give his running, he remains opposable for win purposes.
runners.comment: 0-26 on turf; should run his race but he remains opposable for win purposes

runners.name: Summer Rain
runners.spotlight: 0-15 and he hasn't really threatened to put that right this time around; well drawn but likely vulnerable again.
runners.comment: 15-race maiden; modest form for new yard this year; opposable once more

runners.name: Power Of Chora
runners.spotlight: Just a whiff of promise at a low level; last of eight when favourite at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; returns to 6f with new headgear.
runners.comment: Whiff of promise at a low level but below her best last time; new headgear today

runners.name: The Good Biscuit
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways with a hard-fought success at Catterick (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; goes well at Pontefract and he is a major player despite a small rise in the weights.
runners.comment: Back to winning ways at Catterick 11 days ago; goes well here too; leading contender

runners.name: Iris Dancer
runners.spotlight: Best known for her Hamilton exploits (12 wins) but she ran well over 5f here in the spring and couldn't be arriving in better form, winning three of her last five; contender.
runners.comment: Prolific Hamilton winner but has run well here too; contender

runners.name: Goyard
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Ripon (6f, soft and 5f, good) last summer; good run over 5f here on his seasonal return in June; backwards step at Ripon latest; others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: Two Ripon wins as a 3yo; one good run and one lesser effort so far this year

runners.name: Bell Shot
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; series of good runs at around 7f since May; slipping down the weights and should be a key player back at 6f.
runners.comment: Running well over further on turf since May; down in weights; contender back at 6f
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd

runners.name: Salkadan
runners.spotlight: Had six runs for Dan Skelton on the Flat, finishing second and first in opening two handicaps (at about 1m4f) before a poor final run; has since had wind surgery and should make a hurdler.
runners.comment: Poor last time on the Flat but had a wind op since and he was a winner in that scene

runners.name: Vietnorm
runners.spotlight: After a gelding operation he won two 1m2f handicaps and comfortably accounted for three rivals on his hurdling debut; suffered early interference when only fifth in his latest Flat run; in good nick but the penalty asks something of him.
runners.comment: Done well under both codes since a gelding operation; does carry a penalty

runners.name: Us Officer
runners.spotlight: One competitive run in six Flat starts and exposed as modest; runner-up last week at Newton Abbot but he was beaten 12l by the winner in a poor-looking race.
runners.comment: Flat maiden; runner-up last week at Newton Abbot but he was beaten 12l by the winner

runners.name: Zooter
runners.spotlight: Nine-race Flat maiden but was placed and had a similar level of form in that sphere to Salkadan; could go well on hurdling debut and Sean Bowen is 7-14 for the yard.
runners.comment: Fair Flat form despite maiden status; Sean Bowen is 7-14 for the yard

runners.name: Nicolai
runners.spotlight: Modest form in five defeats for Jack Channon (7f-1m) and wouldn't be the obvious answer on hurdling/stable debut; cheekpieces replace a visor.
runners.comment: Modest form in five defeats for Jack Channon (7f-1m) and wouldn't be the obvious answer

runners.name: Adba
runners.spotlight: Left Ralph Beckett for 9,500gns and as a five-race maiden (1m-9.4f); it wasn't a bad final run (fifth of ten; in a tongue-tie and cheekpieces) and as a 3yo filly she receives all the allowances.
runners.comment: 0-5 on the Flat but some ability and as a 3yo filly she receives all the allowances

runners.name: Al Za'ama
runners.spotlight: Ran three times for Andrew Balding, the standout run when fourth of eight in a 1m AW novice in December; changed hands for 2,600gns and now gelded.
runners.comment: 0-3 for Andrew Balding and left that yard for 2,600gns; gelded since

runners.name: Keep Under Wraps
runners.spotlight: 9-4 for a Newton Abbot maiden and was competitive when running out at the penultimate flight, albeit in a three-runner race; could have some part to play.
runners.comment: Only three ran on debut but he was competitive when running out two from home

runners.name: Hello Garda
runners.spotlight: Limited Flat maiden who was well beaten in a small field on his hurdling debut; opposable.
runners.comment: Limited Flat maiden who was well beaten in a small field on his hurdling debut; opposable

runners.name: No Risk Today
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer; lightly raced over hurdles and latest second at Worcester (back at 2m) was her best run yet; has to be of interest.
runners.comment: Lightly raced over hurdles and latest second at Worcester (back at 2m) was best run yet

runners.name: Culligran
runners.spotlight: Has won over hurdles and fences off slightly lower marks and ran a solid race in defeat in a 2m4f handicap chase at Worcester last time (second run for this yard); this drop in trip shouldn't hurt her chances.
runners.comment: Runner-up over fences last time on second run for this yard; on a competitive mark

runners.name: Northern Rose
runners.spotlight: Now 0-26 over hurdles after last week's defeat at Stratford but she's knocking on the door; unlikely to be far away off the same mark.
runners.comment: Now 0-26 over hurdles after last week's defeat at Stratford but she's knocking on the door

runners.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners.spotlight: Taunton winner in April (2m1f, good) but signed off for Tom Lacey on a low note and ran fairly miserably on last month's stable debut.
runners.comment: Has one win to her name but ran fairly miserably on last month's stable debut

runners.name: Myfavouritesister
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden who has the odd piece of respectable form but she hasn't always looked straightforward and best efforts have been between 2m4f and 3m; blinkers replace cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Hasn't always looked straightforward and best efforts have been between 2m4f and 3m

runners.name: Curious Mrs Fox
runners.spotlight: Longstanding Flat maiden who is 0-5 over hurdles; beaten about 9l last time at Hexham but she's unconvincing.
runners.comment: Longstanding Flat maiden who is 0-5 over hurdles; fair latest run but unconvincing

runners.name: Granny B
runners.spotlight: Flat winner who is 0-19 over hurdles and hasn't been running well this year; 1lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Flat winner who is 0-19 over hurdles and hasn't been running well this year

runners.name: Lady Fortune
runners.spotlight: After a wind operation she was first and fourth in 2m4f/2m7f handicaps for previous yard; joined this one for £3,000 and coped fine with the drop back to 2m when a clearcut winner here 11 days ago; raised 8lb but she's clearly turned a corner.
runners.comment: Won two of her last three, doing it comfortably on recent stable debut here; raised 8lb

runners.name: Jukebox Annie
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner; had plenty of chances in handicaps and was a long way behind No Risk Today in the latest; now goes in a tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Had plenty of chances in handicaps and was a long way behind No Risk Today in the latest

runners.name: Prettylady
runners.spotlight: Won her first two handicaps by a length and latest Bangor run (after a collective 13lb rise) was too bad to be true; could yet prove herself worthy of this mark.
runners.comment: 2-3 in handicaps and latest run too bad to be true; could still be worthy of this mark

runners.name: Dotties Promise
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner but no sign of that form over hurdles and now makes her handicap debut; risky.
runners.comment: Bumper winner but no sign of that form over hurdles and now makes her handicap debut
runners.owner: Castle View Racing & W F Corbett

runners.name: Drombeg Lad
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and off the mark in ready fashion in a 2m maiden at Worcester earlier this month; this mark might be okay.
runners.comment: Readily off the mark in a Worcester maiden and this mark might be okay

runners.name: War Correspondent
runners.spotlight: Not straightforward and hard to win with at the best of times; tailed off last time at Stratford on yard debut.
runners.comment: Not straightforward and hard to win with at the best of times

runners.name: Bright Legend
runners.spotlight: Only win in 18 runs over hurdles was in a maiden on penultimate start in April, that after finishing a well-held third in a 2m4f handicap; latest run at Punchestown three months ago is forgiven (tried a visor) but he's unconvincing against some of these.
runners.comment: Latest run at Punchestown three months ago is forgiven (tried a visor) but unconvincing

runners.name: Emerald Time
runners.spotlight: It was only a Class 5 he won at Worcester (2m, good) but that was straightforward in the new tongue-tie and he ran fairly well off a 6lb rise in a small-field Class 3 at Newton Abbot; travels strongly and well worth considering down 1lb.
runners.comment: Held his own in a small-field Class 3 last time and worth considering down 1lb

runners.name: Romany Brown
runners.spotlight: Irish maiden hurdle winner; tailed off in two handicaps on either side of a fall and wouldn't be the percentage play.
runners.comment: Tailed off in two handicaps on either side of a fall and wouldn't be the percentage play
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

runners.name: King Sacre
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in his first handicap (on good) before making all the running on soft ground at Hexham; went up 9lb for that but failed to give his true running at Perth after racing freely; not yet exposed.
runners.comment: Clearcut Hexham winner who raced too freely when tailed off at Perth

runners.name: Sunray Shadow
runners.spotlight: Four wins since May divided between hurdles and fences; had a nice bit in hand when beating three rivals (including Sony Bill) over C&D 11 days ago and a 4lb rise could have been worse; on a roll and firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: On a roll over hurdles and fences; recent C&D winner and still looks handily treated
runners.owner: S T Racing - The Founders' Syndicate

runners.name: The Flying Poet
runners.spotlight: 2-3 over fences after his workmanlike 3l win at Perth (3m, good) where he was returning from wind surgery and wore first-time blinkers; went up 7lb but gets in here off a low weight and there could be further progress in him.
runners.comment: 2-3 over fences after his workmanlike 3l win at Perth; up 7lb but off a low weight here

runners.name: Hold Your Fort
runners.spotlight: Multiple chase winner who did well last season but he failed to fire behind Imperial Alex in last month's Summer Cup here and was no better returned to hurdles 16 days ago.
runners.comment: Failed to fire behind Imperial Alex here last month and quiet over hurdles since then

runners.name: Sure Touch
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 5-15 over fences, winning a small-field handicap at Market Rasen in October (2m5f, good; has won over 2m7f) for the last of those wins; his close third of four on his belated return to hurdling last month was an encouraging run and should have teed him up nicely for this; on a fair mark and that's without factoring in his jockey's claim.
runners.comment: Strike-rate of 5-15 over fences; recent run over hurdles was encouraging

runners.name: Grand Clermont
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing in France but he's better than ever currently and ran fourth behind Imperial Alex here before a straightforward win over Perth's 3m two weeks ago (good); up 6lb with Rian Corcoran again claiming his 5lb; respected.
runners.comment: Good fourth here before winning comfortably at Perth and respected off 5lb higher

runners.name: Imperial Alex
runners.spotlight: Back on top of his game and a 4lb rise for his half-length win in the Summer Cup over C&D isn't the end of the world; solid chance.
runners.comment: 4lb rise for his half-length win in the Summer Cup over C&D isn't the end of the world

runners.name: Sony Bill
runners.spotlight: Won twice in France but winless for Willie Mullins despite showing useful form on occasions over hurdles; left that yard for 64,000gns; ran no race on stable debut (second chase start) but did show more behind Sunray Shadow here 11 days ago, though that was his first run at 3m and he didn't appear to get home.
runners.comment: Didn't appear to stay the trip when behind Sunray Shadow over C&D 11 days ago

runners.name: Roger Pol
runners.spotlight: Trip/ground is ideal but that was also the case when he finished tailed off here 19 days ago after wind surgery; that was his third underwhelming run on the bounce; tongue-tie tried last time is joined by cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Trip/ground is ideal but that also the case when he finished tailed off here 19 days ago

runners.name: Tyson
runners.spotlight: His wins were Class 5 handicaps and he came up shy in a Class 4 at Stratford last time off a 2lb lower mark (2m6f); looks a good bet to give his running but it's hard to call him well handicapped.
runners.comment: Looks a good bet to give his running but it's hard to call him well handicapped

runners.name: Shallow River
runners.spotlight: Has had only four races for Olly Murphy, the last two after a long absence; held his own in a 2m7f Worcester handicap last month won by the progressive Sunray Shadow who contests the previous race; fair shout off just 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Held his own in a 2m7f Worcester handicap last month won by the progressive Sunray Shadow

runners.name: Idaho Fire
runners.spotlight: An improved third in a novice hurdle on final run for Paul Nicholls, whom he left for £21,000; made an immediate impact for James Owen when making all on his handicap debut at Worcester (2m4f, good; by 3l off 7lb lower); in deeper here but remains something of an unknown quantity.
runners.comment: Made a successful stable/handicap debut; in deeper here but rather an unknown quantity

runners.name: Pike Road
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Worcester before another disappointing run over fences (0-3); no surprise to see him back hurdling but the first-time visor is a grey area; others perhaps safer.
runners.comment: No surprise to see him back over hurdles but the first-time visor is a grey area

runners.name: Paddy De Pole
runners.spotlight: Hasn't had all that much racing for an 8yo and he's a four-time winner over hurdles; not far off his best when runner-up in a small field over 2m4f at Worcester and he needs further than that ideally; player.
runners.comment: Not far off his best when runner-up in a small field over 2m4f at Worcester

runners.name: Karnaval Point
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 6yo who has hit the ground running for David Pipe, winning two of his three starts (all over fences; 2m4f-3m); the latest here over 3m was fairly comfortable and he's 1lb lower for this return to hurdles over which he won in France; clear chance.
runners.comment: 2-3 over fences since joining David Pipe and on a dangerous mark back over hurdles

runners.name: Divilabother
runners.spotlight: Has done well since arriving from Ireland and was delivered late to win handicaps at Hexham (extended 2m7f), Cartmel (2m6f) and here on Friday (2m4f) when he sat last for a long way but won easily in the end; huge chance if turned out quickly with a penalty.
runners.comment: Easy winner here on Friday and huge chance if turned out quickly with a penalty

runners.name: Zillow
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle/Flat winner who left Willie Mullins for 24,000gns after some heavy defeats; he suffered another one on stable debut at Cartmel four weeks ago; unraced beyond about 2m4f.
runners.comment: No sign of recapturing his form when tailed off on stable debut at Cartmel

runners.name: Ras Kassar
runners.spotlight: Won all sorts in France, the latest a hurdle race over 2m2f on good ground in May; only 7-2 for British debut at Perth (2m handicap chase, good) but folded when it mattered; the hood returns today and it worked well for him in France.
runners.comment: Folded on British debut but the hood (returns today) worked well for him in France

runners.name: Country Park
runners.spotlight: Failed to win in 11 runs over hurdles (had placed form) but off the mark over fences on just his second attempt, flooring the favourite in a small field at Bangor (extended 2m4f, good; cheekpieces returned); that could prove a springboard to better things; only 1lb higher.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but soon off the mark over fences and this could be more his game

runners.name: Lakefield Flyer
runners.spotlight: A third win over fences at Stratford last month (extended 2m3f) and it was only five days later when he was third off his lower hurdle mark; had 21 days off since but is 3lb higher than at Stratford in a race that should take more winning.
runners.comment: Hurdling last time; 3lb higher than for recent chase win and this can take more winning

runners.name: Palamon
runners.spotlight: Back today from a second wind operation and it took him a while to find his form after the first; only four ran when third in his latest race and he does look on a stiff mark, 10lb higher than for the easy Bangor win in March.
runners.comment: Looks high in the weights, 10lb higher than for the easy Bangor win in March

runners.name: Gateau De Miel
runners.spotlight: Picked up a weak race on stable debut at Stratford (2m5f, good to firm); subsequent thirds were remote and this race doesn't look a great deal easier.
runners.comment: Won a weak race on stable debut and subsequent thirds were remote

runners.name: At The Oche
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle (2m, good) last year and was runner-up in all his three handicaps (1m7f-3m) in 2026; has joined the Skeltons for £22,000 and had wind surgery; now goes over fences and he has the scope and pedigree for it; Harry Skelton's chosen one from three stable runners.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler off this mark; interesting chase debutant for new yard after wind op

runners.name: Belle Le Grand
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-12 over hurdles and she's had a wind operation after a couple of lesser efforts; has never won over this far but has a pointing background; presumably neglected by Harry Skelton.
runners.comment: 3-12 over hurdles; goes chasing after a wind op; Harry Skelton has looked elsewhere

runners.name: A Dublin Job
runners.spotlight: Did well over fences for Harry Derham but nothing to show for three runs since leaving that trainer; tries a visor.
runners.comment: Did well over fences for Harry Derham but nothing to show for three runs since leaving

runners.name: Hudson
runners.spotlight: Maiden; got in on the act in handicap hurdles but he's not bred for fences and it's showing, having departed early on his first attempt and always behind next time; reservations for now in this discipline.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler but he's not bred for fences and it's showing
runners.owner: Miss Jayne Brace & Mrs Karen Smith

runners.name: Buddah Castle
runners.spotlight: Won a small-field maiden hurdle in December; essentially disappointing since and he was out the back when unseating in handicaps over fences and hurdles.
runners.comment: Out the back when unseating in handicaps over fences and hurdles
runners.owner: T Alderson & Ales And Dales Syndicate

runners.name: Jafimgoso
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; took a while to get his act together over hurdles but got up close home at Ludlow (2m5f, good) in May and, although a beaten favourite, he's run creditably over about 3m/3m2f in his two starts since; needs to resume progress in today's first-time headgear.
runners.comment: 2m5f winner in May who's run creditably at 3m+ since; first-time headgear

runners.name: Iamyouare
runners.spotlight: Won at Hereford (extended 2m3f, good) in April but seemed unsuited by dropping back to 2m1f next time and fell at the first when favourite over 3m on latest outing; may yet build on that win.
runners.comment: Won at Hereford (extended 2m3f, good) in April; favourite, fell at the first latest (3m)

runners.name: Royal Rocket
runners.spotlight: Five starts, best when runner-up in maiden hurdle at Warwick (2m3f, good) in May; 3m saw him tail off at Market Rasen one month later; probably needs overall improvement.
runners.comment: 2nd in maiden at Warwick (2m3f, good) in May; tailed off over 3m one month later

runners.name: Purple Owl
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who's 0-8 under rules and there have been a few blips in his form; rallied when a good second over 2m at Worcester (good) on penultimate start but not proven beyond that, despite several attempts; tongue tied on last five starts and now also sports cheekpieces.
runners.comment: 0-8 under rules, with a few blips in his form; not proven beyond 2m; cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Pure Logic
runners.spotlight: 0-11 overall, mostly in Ireland, and she's not yet lived up to her bumper form; cheekpieces last four starts, tailed off in a handicap at Stratford (extended 2m2f) latest; stays 2m4f but this needs to be one of her good days.
runners.comment: 0-11 overall, mostly in Ireland; tailed off in a Stratford handicap (extended 2m2f) latest

runners.name: Beny Nahar Road
runners.spotlight: Has stronger form over fences and well beaten on return to hurdling for his three starts this May-July; has another career-low jumps mark and his only two races over 2m3f-2m5f were solid, so not entirely ruled out.
runners.comment: Career-low mark; his only two races at 2m3f-2m5f were solid, so not entirely ruled out

runners.name: Crafty Gael
runners.spotlight: No win from 14 races, all over hurdles in Ireland for Ross O'Sullivan; 800-day absence before beaten over 30l in his three starts this spring; tongue tied first time on this debut for new connections and, although best efforts at up to 2m1f, could be interesting if strong in the market.
runners.comment: 0-14 as Irish hurdler; off 800 days before beaten over 30l this spring; check the market

runners.name: Luminaries
runners.spotlight: 4-24 over hurdles, with all wins (2m4f-3m) in spring 2025; latest was off 15lb higher than today, as he's usually not shown much spark since; cheekpieces (last tried seven starts back) return.
runners.comment: 4-24 over hurdles, with all wins (2m4f-3m) in spring 2025; usually not much spark since

runners.name: Warner's Cross
runners.spotlight: Won at Market Rasen (2m5f, good) in June 2024 but he's not seen much action since and struggled over hurdles and fences on last five outings (for Clare Hobson); now 14lb lower than for his win and was second favourite at Worcester (2m7f; six-runner race) ten days ago, but refused to line up; wore cheekpieces twice recently and now it's a hood; 4lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Left Clare Hobson; second favourite at Worcester ten days ago, but refused to line up

runners.name: Illico De Montave
runners.spotlight: No better than fourth after a point, two bumpers and nine hurdle races; has not lived up to initial hurdles form; 8lb out of the handicap for this first run in 11 months and September's wind operation needs to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: 8lb out of the handicap for this first run in 11 months; had wind operation in September

runners.name: Uhtred Ragnarson
runners.spotlight: Returned after six months off with a win in a Warwick handicap (2m, good) last November; back near that form when third of six at Stratford four weeks ago but he has not yet ventured beyond 2m1f.
runners.comment: Warwick win last November; back near that form latest but he has not ventured beyond 2m1f

runners.name: October Hill
runners.spotlight: Breakthrough winner in five-runner handicap at Ffos Las (2m4f, good to soft) in May and she was in contention when brought down three out at Worcester (extended 2m4f, good) last month; both were under Rian Corcoran; cheekpieces (tried three runs back) return; one to consider.
runners.comment: Won at Ffos Las (2m4f) in May and in contention when brought down last month; considered

runners.name: The Secret Pearl
runners.spotlight: Sole win (18 races under rules) was in a maiden hurdle in April 2025; twice runner-up in handicaps over this sort of trip late last year but she needs to improve on her recent efforts; tried cheekpieces on latest.
runners.comment: Twice runner-up in handicaps; needs to improve on recent efforts; tried cheekpieces latest

runners.name: Sonyourastar
runners.spotlight: 0-6 pointing in Ireland; four starts over hurdles for Olly Murphy, the best of which was his fourth of ten on handicap debut at Perth (2m4f, good) last time, with a tongue-tie enlisted; co-favourite that day and he now has something more to build on.
runners.comment: Co-favourite, 4th of ten on handicap debut at Perth (2m4f, good) was something to build on

runners.name: Fiskardo
runners.spotlight: Led on the post in a good-ground Perth bumper in April, after a long layoff; comparable form since over hurdles at Ffos Las (2m, good to soft) and Worcester (2m, good); could do with more fluency over the hurdles but this longer trip should help on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Could do with more jumping fluency but this longer trip should help on handicap debut

runners.name: Papillondelumiere
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in points and soundly beaten at 100-1 and 200-1 in his three maiden hurdles, latest when upped from 2m to 2m5f; had wind surgery since and cheekpieces are also now recruited for this handicap debut (from 3lb wrong).
runners.comment: 0-6 pointing; soundly beaten in maiden hurdles; wind op and cheekpieces for handicap debut

runners.name: Mc'flo
runners.spotlight: 0-11; has a little ability but this task is tough from 8lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: 0-11; has a little ability but this task is tough from 8lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Tommy Cullen
runners.spotlight: 1-4 over hurdles in 2022-23 and he's since been 1-12 over fences; peak form came in 2m chases early in 2025 and there have been a couple of significant absences since; the backward steps on last two chase starts, however, prompt some caution on this return to hurdling in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: 1-4 over hurdles in 2022-23 and 1-12 over fences; backward steps on last two chase starts

runners.name: Stronghold
runners.spotlight: Got the job done by 2 1/2l over 7f at Santa Anita (allowance Grade 3) two months ago; on a hat-trick and record shows he knows where the winning post is (wins-runs career record of 5-14); strong claims given his record when fresh.
runners.comment: Leading claims as he has defied a similar absence in the past.

runners.name: Cornucopian
runners.spotlight: Successful three times in his last four starts; narrow winner of an allowance Grade 3 at Churchill Downs when accounting for two of these two months ago; form of the yard is a plus; poses a threat.
runners.comment: He shouldn't be far away; narrow win two months ago.
runners.owner: Bashor Racing LLC, Front Row Club Et Al

runners.name: Mad House
runners.spotlight: Behind Cornucopian at Churchill Downs in an allowance Grade 3 when not beaten that far two months ago; career wins-runs record of 6-13.
runners.comment: Finished fifth two months ago; career record shows his ability to win (wins-runs record of 6-13).

runners.name: Dr. Venkman
runners.spotlight: Not far behind Gold Sweep when last (Churchill Downs) last month (muddy track) in an allowance Grade 3; he was in the money in a Grade 2 in September and course specialist (four wins from seven); has won in classy company before and is a player.
runners.comment: Likely to be in contention if replicating his best form.
runners.owner: Alipony Racing, Dan J Agnew Et Al

runners.name: Listenupshance
runners.spotlight: Has scored over C&D; yet to win a race of this value; respectable display to finish third, beaten less than a length in an allowance Grade 3 at Saratoga last month; others more likely as could be out of his comfort zone at this level.
runners.comment: Has always come up a bit short at this level in the past so others more likely.
runners.owner: Great Friends Stables & Run Fast Racing

runners.name: Gold Sweep
runners.spotlight: Proven that he knows how to get his head in front (seeking a sixth career win) but wins have come at a lower level; respectable effort to finish fourth, beaten just over 5l (muddy track) last month (Churchill Downs) in an allowance Grade 3; may have to settle for supporting role given many of his rivals are in good form.
runners.comment: Unlikely to achieve more than just a supporting role as this is competitive.

runners.name: Moonlight
runners.spotlight: Career record shows his ability to win (wins-runs record of 6-25); not beaten too far when seventh at Churchill Downs in a Grade 3 four weeks ago; others more likely as this looks a decent race.
runners.comment: A few rivals look in good form so looks an unlikely winner.

runners.name: Maximum Bourbon
runners.spotlight: Easy black type winner three months ago at Churchill Downs on debut for this trainer; four from six in his career so far; jockey does well from inside draws here so could be of some interest.
runners.comment: Jockey does well from inside draws here so could be interesting.
runners.owner: Agave Racing Stable, Evan Trommer & Rockin Robin Racing

runners.name: For All Mankind
runners.spotlight: Beaten a head at Lone Star Park in May in a black type; a while since his last success and yet to win a race of this value.
runners.comment: Not beaten far in May; wins-runs record of 3-23.

runners.name: Vibe Check
runners.spotlight: All the way-cropmis when 2/1 and 1st of 14 runners, 0.40 lengths ahead VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Impressive-drawn widest.

runners.name: Viking Leader
runners.spotlight: Stubb-shift-assert when 16/1 and 1st of 12 runners, 0.80 lengths ahead VIKING LEADER over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Getting better-plum gate.
runners.owner: Melanie L Roberts, J Te Riele & G R & Mrs I Schulze

runners.name: Green Energy
runners.spotlight: Slow - last at 400m when 25/2 and 2nd of 14 runners, 0.40 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Attractive last effort.
runners.owner: L M Nestadt, G Ciucci et al

runners.name: Secretary Bird
runners.spotlight: Hamper st.-goodfin. when 14/1 and 3rd of 14 runners, 0.65 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Eye catching last time.

runners.name: Moana
runners.spotlight: Hung in from 300m when 67/100 and 1st of 8 runners, 5.25 lengths ahead MOANA over 1600m at TURFFONTEIN INSIDE on 29 June 26. Could be a star.
runners.owner: S Mathen, Joshua Peter & TKP Racing

runners.name: Red Spice
runners.spotlight: Slow - ran on well when 7/1 and 4th of 14 runners, 1.25 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Fair form - drawn wide.
runners.owner: T Gujadhur, J M Lim Fat et al

runners.name: Kazenoyoni
runners.spotlight: Hung out 400-150m when 8/1 and 10th of 14 runners, 4.95 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Ignore last run, ability.

runners.name: Bachata
runners.spotlight: Bump-shift-goodfin. when 6/1 and 3rd of 12 runners, 1.40 lengths behind VIKING LEADER over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Nice type, can improve.
runners.owner: T Gujadhur, R M Sewgoolam & Wernars Family

runners.name: Tudor Rose
runners.spotlight: Difficult - ran on when 14/1 and 3rd of 14 runners, 1.60 lengths behind PALACE OF ARVERNIA over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Can't fault her-draw one.

runners.name: The Bronx Bull
runners.spotlight: Pace - no extra when 5/2 and 2nd of 11 runners, 1.00 lengths behind ANTONIO GAUDI over 1200m at TURFFONTEIN INSIDE on 29 June 26. Improved again-1600....
runners.owner: G G Palmer & Mrs D Palmer

runners.name: Erik Dubois
runners.spotlight: Late progress when 25/1 and 6th of 14 runners, 2.95 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Could make things pay.

runners.name: Prayersandpromises
runners.spotlight: Hung in 300m when 8/1 and 5th of 14 runners, 2.75 lengths behind VIBE CHECK over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Nice type-expect more.

runners.name: Better Never Ends
runners.spotlight: Slow-quickened-game when 33/20 and 1st of 5 runners, 0.20 lengths ahead BETTER NEVER ENDS over 1200m at GREYVILLE POLYTRACK on 20 June 26. Talented, now 1600m...

runners.name: Life In Colour
runners.spotlight: Never in doubt when 3/1 and 1st of 13 runners, 2.60 lengths ahead LIFE IN COLOUR over 1400m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 11 July 26. Getting better-now 1600m.
runners.owner: R P Macnab, D G Bailie Et Al

runners.name: Asiye Phambili
runners.spotlight: Smashing finish! when 5/1 and 1st of 14 runners, 0.20 lengths ahead ASIYE PHAMBILI over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. Gallant 3rd in 2025.

runners.name: Questioning
runners.spotlight: Brushed-gameGr1win when 11/2 and 1st of 12 runners, 0.05 lengths ahead QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. 9th in 2025-now big say.
runners.owner: Greg & Gina Bortz, T Gujadhur & Wernars Family

runners.name: Buffalo Storm Cody
runners.spotlight: Moved up - tried when 14/10 and 2nd of 14 runners, 0.50 lengths behind JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 2025 winner-can repeat.

runners.name: Cosmic Speed
runners.spotlight: Over-race-ease-hung when 25/1 and 5th of 12 runners, 3.45 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Can pop up here, watch.
runners.owner: T Gujadhur, R M Sewgoolam & Wernars Family

runners.name: Jet Force
runners.spotlight: Crop misuse-topfin. when 20/1 and 1st of 14 runners, 0.50 lengths ahead JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Impressive last win.
runners.owner: Denis Le Breton, A L Taylor Et Al

runners.name: Mia Moo
runners.spotlight: Carriedin-jck-short when 25/2 and 7th of 14 runners, 4.20 lengths behind ASIYE PHAMBILI over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. 11th last year - can show.

runners.name: Taxi To The Moon
runners.spotlight: Fought on gamely when 28/10 and 1st of 8 runners, 0.30 lengths ahead TAXI TO THE MOON over 1160m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 05 July 26. Spotless form-big test.

runners.name: Tenango
runners.spotlight: Slow-shifted-goodF. when 25/2 and 3rd of 14 runners, 0.55 lengths behind JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 2nd in 2025 - go close.
runners.owner: T Gujadhur, R M Sewgoolam & Wernars Family

runners.name: O'Tenikwa
runners.spotlight: Awkplc-ease-unlucky when 14/1 and 6th of 15 runners, 1.65 lengths behind TAXI TO THE MOON over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. Dark horse after rest.

runners.name: Cats Pajamas
runners.spotlight: No show when 16/1 and 10th of 14 runners, 5.30 lengths behind JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 4th in 2025 - can earn.

runners.name: Cafe Culture
runners.spotlight: Led - tired late when 25/2 and 7th of 14 runners, 3.70 lengths behind JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 5th in 2025 - can earn.
runners.owner: M I Fullard, J H Drew & Mrs L Drew

runners.name: Green Diamond
runners.spotlight: Fatigued when 20/1 and 4th of 14 runners, 3.20 lengths behind BUFFALO STORM CODY over 1000m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 04 April 26. Has talent - big task.

runners.name: Gladatorian
runners.spotlight: Moved up-stayed on when 20/1 and 7th of 18 runners, 5.00 lengths behind NOTE TO SELF over 2200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 2025 winner-same draw!.
runners.owner: Messrs E G Hart De Keating, M L Jean Hardy Et Al

runners.name: Legal Counsel
runners.spotlight: Heels clipped-vet-N when 20/1 and 12th of 18 runners, 12.10 lengths behind NOTE TO SELF over 2200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. Ignore last-has the class.
runners.owner: Messrs Cameron Braun, E A Braun Et Al

runners.name: See It Again
runners.spotlight: Steadied2x-shortR/F when 7/2 and 8th of 12 runners, 5.45 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. 3rd in 2025-can score now.

runners.name: Main Defender
runners.spotlight: Interference 300m when 25/1 and 9th of 12 runners, 5.95 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Has the ability-can show.
runners.owner: J J Habib, G Nassif Et Al

runners.name: Dave The King
runners.spotlight: Hung in-bump 150m when 25/2 and 13th of 14 runners, 9.65 lengths behind JET FORCE over 1200m at GREYVILLE on 04 July 26. 5th in 2025-can pop up.
runners.owner: L M Nestadt, Gary Player Stud Farm Ltd & Ralphs Racing Ltd

runners.name: The Real Prince
runners.spotlight: Made inroads when 9/2 and 4th of 12 runners, 2.95 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. 2nd in 2025-same draw!.

runners.name: Eight On Eighteen
runners.spotlight: Rolled in-exam-nil when 4/1 and 10th of 12 runners, 10.55 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. His main aim-watch out.

runners.name: Malmesbury Missile
runners.spotlight: Directed out 200m when 25/1 and 5th of 11 runners, 6.90 lengths behind STAR MAJOR over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Good 3-Y-O - tested here.
runners.owner: Itssa It Solutions & World Sports Betting

runners.name: Wimbledon Hawkeye
runners.spotlight: Smart form as a 2yo, albeit behind Hotazhell in the Group 1 Futurity Trophy Stakes, and continued to produce solid efforts as a 3yo and this year, with his win in the Grade 3 Nashville Derby last August (1m2f110yds, firm) his best performance until finishing runner-up in the Wolferton Stakes 40 days ago; since joined new trainer and owners and shapes like a leading contender is an ordinary race for the level; Oisin Murphy on for first time.
runners.comment: Starts off in a Group 1 for new connections having posted a career best last time

runners.name: Silawi
runners.spotlight: Biggest moment came when landing last year's Grade 1 Canadian International (1m4f, firm) and went one to back that up in the Jebel Hatta (1m1f, good), another top-level event at the start of the 2026; slight concern that he'd not been seen since respectable effort in Saudi Arabia in February but dangerous to write him off completely; seems to handle most ground and fully effective at this trip.
runners.comment: Grade 1 winner on firm ground; slight concern is he's been off for so long

runners.name: Hotazhell
runners.spotlight: Won Group 1 a 2yo (when Wimbledon Hawkeye was third) but, while running creditably on plenty of occasions, has yet to add to his tally following that Doncaster success; no problems with trip or ground and place potential at the very least if turning up at his best; cheekpieces worn last time are removed.
runners.comment: Has plenty of ability and trip and ground are fine; cheekpieces come off

runners.name: Wemightakedlongway
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of sound form in Group 1s as a 3yo, notably being runner-up in the Irish Oaks (1m4f, good) and fourth in the Prix de l'Opera at Longchamp (1m2f, very soft), but has been well below that level  this season in various headgear, although last start in a first-time visor was a respectable run as a 50-1 shot; chance likely rely on if first-time blinkers has a positive effect.
runners.comment: Seeking a return to his her 3yo best; various headgear being tried, while last run was ok

runners.name: Coedana
runners.spotlight: Improving filly, who has emerged out of handicaps to be a smart performer, following a sound effort at Goodwood on her reappearance with a big run behind Group 1 performer Estrange and then a Listed race success just over a month ago over 1m4f on good; possibly still improving but drop in trip would be a concern.
runners.comment: In good form this year but over further; drop in trip a concern
runners.owner: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall

runners.name: Timeforshowcasing
runners.spotlight: Knows how to win, landing three races as a juvenile and two this year, most notably the Group 2 German 1,000 Guineas (1m, soft) in late May; had been well beaten in the 1,000 Guineas at Newmarket prior to that, but showed she can mix it in Group 1s last time, when beaten under 5l in the Coronation Stakes last month (1m, good to firm); enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll stay this trip and gets all the allowances.
runners.comment: Comes into this in respectable form and enough in pedigree to suggest she'll stay

runners.name: Santagada
runners.spotlight: Has a solid strike-rate for a smart performer, and enjoyed a decent 3yo campaign, not beaten far in the German Oaks when not getting a clear run, but landing four Group 3s from a mile to 1m3f on ground from good through to soft; capable of being thereabouts and not dismissed but looks more likely to place than win.
runners.comment: Classy filly at her best and capable of being thereabouts

runners.name: Wilko
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D Group 3 as a 3yo and started this season with a bang when landing a German Listed event by 5l; didn't back that up in Group company after and will need to find extra for a first top-level win; trip fine and seems to handle most ground.
runners.comment: Won a C&D Group 3 as a 3yo but looks to need to find extra to win at this level

runners.name: Seguro
runners.spotlight: Back to showing improved form and comes into this off a couple of Group 3 wins, the most recent at Hamburg over 1m2f on good to soft by a short-head; this demands more but does get the 3yo allowance and should be capable of better.
runners.comment: Back improving and comes into this off a couple of Group 3 wins; capable of better

runners.name: Bella Sinfonia
runners.spotlight: Been performing well in Germany and Italy this year, winning a Listed event then a Group 3 at San Siro (1m2f, soft) before a modest effort at Hamburg three weeks ago when blinkers were removed; headgear goes back on but is left with something to find on the figures.
runners.comment: Italian Group 3 win in June but not so good without blinkers last time; headgear back on

runners.name: Moondance
runners.owner: Omar Esmil Sh Ghrghar & Michael E Kisber

runners.name: Persis
runners.owner: Didier Vida, Mme Sylvie Raffalli et al
